GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, got its head up and missed the start 1 length , Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 4.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted out Four Wide Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line. Hasn't won beyond 1200m but might want a touch further or a longer straight? (Tongue Tie AGAIN) # ran on fairly late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin, then got its head up and lost ground.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear Set  Good Pace , led x 2 Lengths 400m Ridden Along , Collared x 100m and Couldn'T Go On (w/ag) # Went Too Hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated rather than being caught wide, allowed mount to stride. Rdr reported gelding felt awkward in its action over concluding stages. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Caught 3 Wide early Restrained to slot in Settled Down 6th Outside 4 1/2 Lengths Under Pressure x 400m Outside Best Going kept trying without threatening (w/off) # Even Effort
Bit Slow Out Settled Down 6th Inside 5 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths To The Turn , 4th x 300 3rd x 200 now flat - # died on run

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Settled Down well back Inside 12 Lengths with 1st following railed within 8 Lengths Turning for home clear run home in between runners Just Kept Going One Pace - # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m, raced in restricted room for a number of strides.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast Not Bustled Settled Down 6th 4 Lengths following 1st x 1 Lengths To The Turn came home in between runners flat @ 200 Couldn'T Go On - # run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear run on entering the home straight. Rdr reported gelding was disappointing when placed under pressure in the home straight & raced flat. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained Settled Down 6th Inside 8 Lengths off Tearaway Leader Ridden Along Turning for home in between runners bumping, truly Clear x 300 all over x 100m, # simply too good
Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 7th Outside 8 Lengths out 3 Wide x 600 clear run home Best Going 4th x 300 2nd x 200 kept on tough - 1st sat 2nd - # Sound eff/finale

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down Just Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with a trail 6 Lengths out Four Wide x Turn clear run home Kept Coming Closest on line, - Trainer Just Bellamy was fined $100 under AR206(3) for presenting the gelding to race in incorrect gear but them stewards didn't share with us what the incorrect gear was So who knows???? # Sound Effort
